input.quote: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
input.rationale: Section 15.11 (p0833) is the only limitation-of-liability provision: it contains a mutual indirect/consequential damages waiver but no aggregate monetary cap. Article 12 (indemnification), the 13.6 disclaimer and 14.4.2 (which only channels SFJ's termination damages into the Section 14.2 payments) add no cap, and document-wide searches for \"aggregate liability\"/\"shall not exceed\" return nothing responsive, so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited and the fallback (mutual 12-month fee cap with indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carve-outs) fails. The cure sits at fallback: because this Co-Development Agreement has no \"fees\" concept, the twelve-month basis is anchored to the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under Article 6 (the only PB-to-SFJ consideration stream) rather than an indeterminate \"fees\" referent; SFJ's Article 4 obligation to pay or incur Development Costs is carved out of the cap so the new limit cannot cut down PB's failure-to-fund claim; and the existing savings sentence is extended so that all PB payment obligations, not just Article 6 and Section 14.2 amounts, remain outside \"damages\" subject to any cap. We did not volunteer the preferred USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor or the preferred data protection, fraud and IP-infringement carve-outs, which we note remain open at the preferred level.

proposal.summary: Add mutual 12-month cap anchored to PB's Article 6 payments, with carve-outs for indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and SFJ's Article 4 funding obligation, and confirm PB's payment obligations are not capped damages
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives indirect damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual twelve-month cap at our fallback position; because this Agreement has no defined "fees", we anchor the basis to PB's Article 6 payments. Indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and SFJ's Article 4 Development Cost funding obligation sit outside the cap, and we confirm PB's payment obligations are not "damages" subject to it.

ops.text: Except for each Party's indemnification obligations under Article 12, each Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10, each Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and SFJ's obligation to pay or incur Development Costs under Article 4, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under Article 6 in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
